posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: First glimpse of baby Vihaan Kaushal is out, and Katrina has fans gushing as she settles into new motherhood with husband Vicky Kaushal.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' is surging at the box office (a 115% second-weekend jump), even as Diljit makes global headlines — LA declared a 'Diljit Dosanjh Day' and his San Francisco concert drew a wild stage-rush moment.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: The 'Alpha' trailer is out and the YRF Spy Universe film has been preponed to July 3 — while husband Ranbir Kapoor turned heads in a 'My Wife's An Alpha' tee.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: PeeCee confirmed a dream collaboration with Angelina Jolie, joined the Rolex family, and is deep into her Varanasi shoot with Mahesh Babu for 'SSMB29'.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: Buzz around SRK's 'King' (locked for a Dec 24 release) is peaking with leaked BTS clips, while reports say son Aryan Khan will direct him next.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Bebo's 'Daayra' with Prithviraj Sukumaran has locked a Sep 18 release, and she joined the cast of 'Lagaan' to mark the film's 25th anniversary.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha unveiled a never-before-seen avatar as Vithabai in 'Eetha', whose teaser dropped with 'Cocktail 2'; the film hits theatres Aug 28.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Expecting her second child with Ranveer Singh, Deepika is reportedly shooting 'King' with SRK and 'Raaka' with Allu Arjun even through her pregnancy.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Riding the massive success of the 'Dhurandhar' franchise, Ranveer is also in the headlines over his much-discussed exit from 'Don 3'.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Ash stunned at Cannes 2026 in a blush-pink Sophie Couture gown, walking the red carpet with daughter Aaradhya in a viral mother-daughter moment.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: 'Cocktail 2' with Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon opened strong (Rs 13.10cr Day 1), as Rashmika also announced her period drama 'Ranabaali'.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: The trailer for Samantha's action-packed 'Maa Inti Bangaaram' is out, showing her in a fierce housewife-turned-fighter role.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: The Icon Star is shooting 'Raaka' with Atlee and Deepika Padukone in Mumbai, and made a virtual court appearance in the Sandhya Theatre case.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's rural sports drama 'Peddi' (music by AR Rahman) is off to an excellent start, crossing $1.5M in North America premieres.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Gearing up for 'War 2' opposite Hrithik Roshan, NTR has confirmed a packed four-film slate including Prashanth Neel's 'Dragon' and 'Devara 2'.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi stars opposite Ram Charan in the just-released 'Peddi' and continues to be one of Bollywood's busiest young leads.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya shared heartfelt family throwbacks for Father's Day, as 'Call Me Bae' Season 2 (with Shruti Haasan joining) gets confirmed by Prime Video.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Balancing motherhood to baby Saraayah with a packed slate, Kiara opens up on postpartum life ahead of her big release 'Toxic' with Yash.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik returns as super-spy Kabir in YRF's 'War 2', calling it the peak of his career as the spy universe goes global opposite Jr NTR.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun headlines the ensemble comedy 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' alongside Pooja Hegde and Mrunal Thakur, while 'Border 2' buzz builds.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: The melody queen's global 'Unstoppable Tour' rolls on, with North American arena dates announced across the US and Canada this September.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: The Oscar-winning maestro's score for Ram Charan's 'Peddi' is a major highlight as the film opens, drawing fresh praise for his music.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: In a historic shift, Thalapathy Vijay's TVK party swept to power in Tamil Nadu, making the actor the state's first non-Dravidian Chief Minister in 59 years.
